home.title: GreenHeal
home.moodProgress: Track your mood daily to see your progress here

home.supportReadyTitle: Keep your healing space calm and consistent
home.supportReadyBody: You already have plants in your routine. Refresh your room plan, preview new placements, and stay on top of watering.
home.supportEmptyTitle: Start recreating the green comfort of the center
home.supportEmptyBody: Scan or upload your room, choose the plants that fit your recovery needs, and build a calming space to return to every day.
home.actionHintScan: Analyze your room and build a center-inspired design
home.actionHintCare: See what needs water and keep your rhythm steady
home.actionHintJourney: Reflect on progress, triggers, and calming moments
home.actionHintGarden: Review your plants and grow your green support system
home.dailyRhythmSubtitle: A small, supportive plan to help you check in, care gently for your space, and notice your progress.
home.dailyActionRestore: Choose one calming action first: drink water, sit near natural light, or write one sentence about what feels hardest today.
home.dailyActionStartSpace: Begin with one healing action for your room: scan your space and create your first calming plant plan.
home.dailyActionStress: Spend two quiet minutes with a plant, slow your breathing, and notice one part of the room that already feels softer.
home.dailyActionSleep: Prepare your evening space early: reduce visual clutter, water only what needs care, and keep the room restful tonight.
home.dailyActionPhysical: Choose one light restorative task today: sit comfortably, care for one plant, and pause before pushing your energy too far.
home.dailyActionReconnect: Pick one life-giving action today: open the curtains, care for one plant, or write one kind sentence to yourself.
home.dailyActionWellness: Keep your healing routine simple today: check in with your mood, care for one plant, and notice one thing that is improving.
home.reflectionStress: What helped your body feel a little safer or calmer today?
home.reflectionSleep: What made your room feel more restful today, even in a small way?
home.reflectionPhysical: What supported your comfort, strength, or energy today?
home.reflectionDepression: What helped you feel even slightly more present or connected today?
home.reflectionWellness: What healthy moment do you want to repeat tomorrow?
home.stepOneBody: Upload a real photo of your space so GreenHeal can design around your home, not a generic template.
home.stepTwoBody: Choose multiple plants that recreate the calming atmosphere of the specialist center and match your recovery focus.
home.stepThreeBody: Follow watering reminders and simple care guidance so the room stays restorative over time.

moodSupport.default: Take a slow breath and choose the feeling that is closest to today. There is no wrong answer.
moodSupport.1: Thank you for checking in. Be extra gentle with yourself today and keep the next step very small.
moodSupport.2: You are showing up even on a hard day. Aim for comfort, hydration, and one quiet supportive action.
moodSupport.3: Thank you for noticing where you are. A steady, simple routine can help keep the day grounded.
moodSupport.4: It's good to see a lighter moment today. Try to protect it with one calming habit you can repeat.
moodSupport.5: I'm glad today feels brighter. Capture what is helping so you can return to it again.

tips.0: Lavender can reduce anxiety and improve sleep quality

tips.2: Snake plants release oxygen at night, perfect for bedrooms
tips.3: Jasmine fragrance can reduce stress and improve mood
tips.5: Chamomile tea from fresh flowers aids relaxation
tips.6: Mint leaves can relieve headaches and improve digestion
tips.7: Peace lilies remove toxins and improve air quality
tips.8: Spider plants are excellent for reducing indoor pollution
tips.9: Basil has anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties

guidedDialogue.subtitle: Before the scan, answer a few gentle questions so GreenHeal can identify your dominant symptoms and tailor the plant plan to your real space.
guidedDialogue.summaryPlaceholder: Select your symptoms, timing, and support goal to personalize the analysis.

sections.symptomsTitle: Which symptoms stand out most right now?
sections.symptomsBody: Choose one or more sensations that best describe what the patient is currently experiencing.
sections.timingTitle: When do these sensations feel strongest?
sections.supportTitle: What kind of support would help the most?

night_waking.label: Frequent night waking
night_waking.hint: Sleep feels light, fragmented, or interrupted several times during the night.

anxiety.label: Mild anxiety
anxiety.hint: There is a low but persistent feeling of tension, worry, or nervous anticipation.

irritability.label: Unusual irritability
irritability.hint: The room feels less patient, more reactive, or emotionally sharp than usual.

restlessness.label: Restlessness
restlessness.hint: Settling down feels difficult, and the body or mind keeps searching for relief.

mental_fatigue.label: Mental fatigue
mental_fatigue.hint: Thinking feels heavy, foggy, or more effortful than normal.

low_mood.label: Low mood
low_mood.hint: The atmosphere feels emotionally flat, discouraged, or lacking warmth.

night.label: At night
night.hint: The room becomes harder to settle into once the evening begins.

morning.label: In the morning
morning.hint: Symptoms are strongest when waking up or starting the day.

afternoon.label: In the afternoon
afternoon.hint: Energy drops or overstimulation build up across the middle of the day.

evening.label: In the evening
evening.hint: The room feels heavier, louder, or less calming later in the day.

all_day.label: Throughout the day
all_day.hint: The need for support remains present most of the time.

sleep.label: Better sleep support
sleep.hint: Prioritize a quieter pre-sleep atmosphere and more restorative bedtime cues.

calm.label: More calm
calm.hint: Reduce tension and soften the room's sensory pressure.

emotional_balance.label: Emotional balance
emotional_balance.hint: Help the room feel steadier, warmer, and more emotionally supportive.

focus.label: Grounded focus
focus.hint: Create clearer visual order with less mental overstimulation.

reportPreview.title: Weekly report preview
reportPreview.subtitle: This preview gathers a calm summary of your healing activity from the last 7 days.
reportPreview.partialDataNotice: Some report details could not be loaded right now, so this preview may be incomplete.
reportPreview.windowLabel: Based on reflections and plant activity from the last 7 days.
reportPreview.noReflections: No written reflections yet this week.
reportPreview.includesProfile: Your healing focus and basic care-team profile details.
reportPreview.includesJournal: Weekly reflection activity and optional note highlights.
reportPreview.includesPlants: How many plants you are caring for and recent additions.
reportPreview.includesConsent: Only information you review and consent to share.
reportPreview.consentBody: Nothing is sent automatically from this screen. This is only a preview so you can understand what a future hospital or care-team update could contain.
reportPreview.artifactSubtitle: This structured draft shows how GreenHeal can format this week's healing summary for future export or sharing.
reportPreview.artifactLocalNote: This draft stays on the device for now and is not sent from this screen.
reportPreview.reviewSubtitle: Confirm the details below before GreenHeal marks this preview as ready for a future care-team update.
reportPreview.reviewSummaryItem: I reviewed the patient, care-team, and weekly summary details.
reportPreview.reviewConsentItem: I understand this does not send anything yet and that future sharing stays optional.
reportPreview.reviewRequiredNote: Mark both review items before saving this confirmation.
reportPreview.reviewPartialDataNote: Load the full preview before saving a sharing confirmation.
reportPreview.missingProfileNote: Complete your healing profile before saving a sharing confirmation.
reportPreview.savedBody: GreenHeal saved your review confirmation for this weekly summary preview.
reportPreview.handoffSubtitle: Choose how you would prefer to deliver this report later. GreenHeal will only save the handoff plan on this device.
reportPreview.handoffNeedsReviewNote: Save the review confirmation before preparing a handoff plan.
reportPreview.handoffMethodRequiredNote: Choose a handoff method before saving this plan.
reportPreview.handoffPartialDataNote: Load the full preview before preparing a handoff plan.
reportPreview.handoffLocalOnlyNote: This will save a local handoff plan only. Nothing will be exported or sent yet.
reportPreview.handoffSavedBody: GreenHeal saved your preferred handoff method and marked this report as prepared for a future manual delivery step.
reportPreview.handoffNextStepReview: Re-check the weekly report draft before delivering it.
reportPreview.handoffNextStepDeliver: Use your chosen method when you are ready to hand this report to your care team.
reportPreview.handoffNextStepManual: GreenHeal still will not send anything automatically.
reportPreview.handoffSaveError: We couldn't save your handoff plan right now. Please try again.
reportPreview.exportSubtitle: Create a plain-text copy of this weekly report in GreenHeal's local storage for a future manual delivery step.
reportPreview.exportNeedsHandoffNote: Prepare a handoff plan before generating a local export.
reportPreview.exportPartialDataNote: Load the full preview before generating a local export.
reportPreview.exportLocalOnlyNote: This will create a text file on this device only. GreenHeal will not share or send it automatically.
reportPreview.exportSavedBody: GreenHeal created a text copy of this weekly report in local app storage.
reportPreview.exportSaveError: We couldn't generate the local export right now. Please try again.
reportPreview.exportHistorySubtitle: These saved report files stay on this device unless you manually share one.
reportPreview.exportHistoryCleanupError: We couldn't clear the older export history right now. Please try again.
reportPreview.exportHistoryDetailBody: Review this saved local export entry before you share it or clean up older history.
reportPreview.shareSubtitle: Open your device's share options for this local report export. You still choose whether to cancel, save, email, print, or hand it off another way.
reportPreview.shareNeedsExportNote: Generate a local export before opening delivery or share options.
reportPreview.shareLocalOnlyNote: This opens your device's share options manually. GreenHeal still will not send anything on its own.
reportPreview.shareOpenedBody: GreenHeal opened your device's manual share options for this report export.
reportPreview.shareManualNote: Nothing is delivered unless you choose a destination yourself.
reportPreview.shareMessageIntro: GreenHeal prepared this local weekly care-team report for manual delivery.
reportPreview.shareError: We couldn't open the delivery/share options right now. Please try again.
reportPreview.saveError: We couldn't save your review confirmation right now. Please try again.
